tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: The ground. Every console screen is black; bands, pills and text sit directly on it. Never tint it. Only the report theme turns it white, for print.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Content wells inside a Frame and CommLine rows. Barely lighter than surface-000; set it apart with band-gap spacing, not borders.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Raised cards and empty meter segments inside a well. Highest surface; nothing lighter is a surface.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative rules between readouts and the leader dots in a Readout. Carries no meaning, so it needs no contrast floor.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body, readout values and headings on surface-000, surface-100 and surface-200 (17:1 or better in every theme). Also the focus ring on surfaces.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, timestamps and secondary labels on surface-000 through surface-200 (9:1 console, 5.4:1 or better report). Never for values.

tokens.name: ink-on-band
tokens.usage: The only text colour on any band, pill, Button or Status fill. Black in the three console themes; white in the report theme, where bands go dark so they print. Also the focus ring when it lands on a band.

tokens.name: band-primary
tokens.usage: The Ship's lead band: Frame elbows and header bars, primary Buttons, the first Rail segment. ink-on-band on it reads 10.3:1 standard, 13.9:1 yellow alert, 5.0:1 red alert, 5.0:1 report. Also legible as text on surface-000 in every theme (same figures).

tokens.name: band-secondary
tokens.usage: Second Ship band: alternate Rail segments, secondary Buttons, bar segments. ink-on-band on it 8.7:1 / 9.9:1 / 7.5:1 / 6.4:1 across the four themes. Also the info Status fill.

tokens.name: band-tertiary
tokens.usage: Light Ship band for relief between two strong bands, and for Readout meter and Gauge fills. ink-on-band on it 14.7:1 / 18.3:1 / 12.3:1 / 5.9:1.

tokens.name: band-quiet
tokens.usage: Low-emphasis Ship band: filler segments, disabled controls, bar ends, the resting Cascade. ink-on-band on it 5.6:1 / 7.2:1 / 5.8:1 / 7.4:1, so labels are allowed but keep them to numerals.

tokens.name: band-accent
tokens.usage: Rare Ship band for one highlighted segment per screen: the selected Rail item, a decision in the comm channel. ink-on-band on it 9.7:1 / 16:1 / 9.5:1 / 7.3:1.

tokens.name: band-active
tokens.usage: Pressed and hovered state of any band or Button: the fill goes pale (dark in the report theme). ink-on-band on it 19.8:1 / 20.2:1 / 17.3:1 / 14:1.

tokens.name: crew-command
tokens.usage: Command division, the red uniform: chips, cards and Cascade of command-track agents (the one who decides). Identical in the three console themes because the Crew does not go to alert; darkened for report. ink-on-band on it 5.1:1 console, 7.5:1 report; as text on surface-000 the same. Always beside a name, since status-crit is also a red.

tokens.name: crew-ops
tokens.usage: Operations division, the gold uniform: engineering, security, operations agents. ink-on-band on it 10.4:1 console, 6.3:1 report; as text on surface-000 the same. It is a mustard, deliberately duller than band-primary and status-warn so a crew chip never reads as a Ship band or an alert.

tokens.name: crew-science
tokens.usage: Sciences division, the teal uniform: the library and computer agent, medical, sensors analysis. ink-on-band on it 7.4:1 console, 6.1:1 report; as text on surface-000 the same.

tokens.name: crew-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind any agent's message in CommLine, the body of an AgentCard and a selected Table row. One neutral slate for every division so the chip carries the division and the row does not shout. ink on it 15:1 console, 12:1 report. Never a text colour.

tokens.name: status-ok
tokens.usage: Status fill for nominal conditions, with the word NOMINAL on it in ink-on-band (11.7:1 console, 5.3:1 report). Mint rather than green so it leaves the red-green axis and cannot be confused with status-crit by hue alone.

tokens.name: status-warn
tokens.usage: Status fill for DEGRADED and CONDITION YELLOW, with the word on it in ink-on-band (14.5:1 console, 5.1:1 report). As text on surface-000 the same.

tokens.name: status-crit
tokens.usage: Status fill for CRITICAL and RED ALERT, with the word on it in ink-on-band (6.0:1 console, 5.9:1 report). As text on surface-000 the same. Always paired with its word.

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: Status fill for informational states (STANDBY, QUEUED). Aliases band-secondary so it reddens under red alert.

families.text: "Source Sans 3", "Source Sans Pro", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The one page title on a screen, uppercase, in a band colour on surface-000 or ink. Nothing else on a first screen is this size.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Elbow Frame titles (page header only), the AlertBanner word and Dialog titles, uppercase.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section heads on the ground inside a page, uppercase. Rare: a quiet Frame's title bar uses label.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Text on bands and chips only: quiet Frame title bars, Buttons, Rail segments, Status pills, sender chips, AgentCard bands, Table headers. Uppercase, ink-on-band.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: The per-agent index beside a name on an AgentCard band or a CommLine chip, and the optional index on a Button, Rail segment or Frame when a consumer turns it on. Off by default everywhere decorative.

styles.name: body-text
styles.sample: I am pulling the deck 7 maintenance log and the last three conduit inspections.
styles.usage: Everything a person reads for more than a glance: CommLine messages, AgentCard activity, Timeline bodies and titles, Dialog text, Table cells, incident notes. Normal case, ink on surfaces. Weight 600 for a Timeline title or a finding.

styles.name: small-text
styles.usage: Secondary lines in normal case: an AgentCard role and meta line, Readout and Gauge labels (weight 600, in the tone), footnotes. ink-muted unless it names a thing.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Plasma conduit 4 shows a 12% pressure drop over the last 90 seconds.
styles.usage: Tool output only: a tool call and its result in CommLine, raw log excerpts. Never for prose.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Readout, Gauge and Table values and telemetry, in ink. Tabular figures so columns stay aligned while they tick.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps and units, in ink-muted on surfaces.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: band-gap, the black gutter between any two bands. The smallest step; nothing sits closer.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside a pill between label and index numeral; between a Status dot and its word.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding inside Buttons, Rail segments and chips; vertical padding of a compact CommLine row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Padding of a content well; gap between Readouts.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between a quiet Frame's title bar and the first row of a dense panel; column gutter inside a Console grid.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between a Frame's bar and its title; between groups inside a well.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Outer page margin on a console screen; gap between two Frames.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Height of a standard Rail segment; vertical rhythm between major regions.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Height of a tall Rail segment; the display style's line height.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Corners of block-shaped bands and Rail segments, meter segments, cards on surface-200.

tokens.name: radius-elbow-inner
tokens.usage: The concave inner corner where a Frame's rail meets its bar. Always paired with radius-elbow-outer.

tokens.name: radius-elbow-outer
tokens.usage: The convex outer corner of a Frame elbow. The signature shape; use it only on elbows.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, Status pills, sender chips and the free end of every bar: fully rounded ends.

layout.note: Fixed dimensions of the elbow-and-band frame. They do not scale with the viewport; the screen gains content width, never thicker bands.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: Width of the vertical rail down the left of a Frame, and of every Rail segment.

tokens.name: bar-height
tokens.usage: Height of a Frame's horizontal header bar and of any bar segment that continues it.

tokens.name: band-gap
tokens.usage: The black gutter between adjacent bands, bar segments and Rail segments. Equals space-1; never wider.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Height of a Button and a Status pill.

tokens.name: chip-width
tokens.usage: Width of a CommLine sender chip so the message column lines up down the channel.
